# gen
# note one command an exchange and one comment a file: the names survive a
# note pipe to a shell
>>> a.rr
-- a --
GET https://example.com/a HTTP/1.1

>>> b.rr
-- b --
GET https://example.com/b HTTP/1.1

>>> stdout
# {{root}}/a.rr
# a
curl -X GET https://example.com/a

# {{root}}/b.rr
# b
curl -X GET https://example.com/b
